title: model-eol receipt verification
description: Verification report `model-eol/verification@0.1` emitted by `model-eol verify RECEIPT --json`. It names the receipt by path, schema, and the SHA-256 of its bytes, records that the receipt passed structural validation, and lists one entry per claim. A claim is verified (the supplied input reproduces the receipt's value), mismatch (it does not; expected is the receipt's value and actual is what the input produced, null when one side has no such entry), not-checked (input names the flag that would check it), or not-applicable (a no-release receipt makes no such claim). A no-release receipt checked with any release input (--commit, --version, --package) gets a released claim with status mismatch, expected false and actual true. For a feed-refresh receipt, receipt.state, receipt.checked_at, and receipt.pending_pr (pending receipts only) are copied from the receipt as information; they are not claims. Compatibility: additive changes keep this version; validators reject unknown versions. Enforced in code, not by this schema: claim names are unique; a verified claim with both expected and actual has them equal, a mismatch claim has them different, and a not-checked claim names its input; result is mismatch when any claim is mismatch, verified when every applicable claim is verified and at least one is, and partial otherwise.
